EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DN_000: Hey :red_exclamation: Welcome to our [loc]Tavern[/loc]! I am [char]Barman Absinthrayner[/char]. And who might fortune have brought my way?
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DO_000to001_2: Oh, do not ask, I am [italic]cursed[/italic] by fate...
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DO_000to001_3: If you want, I could become [shadow]your[/shadow] best customer :happy:
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DO_001to005_4: Do you know anyone who knows about [quest]spells[/]:question:
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DO_001to990_9: That is all, until next time
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DN_002:
I practically grew up in this [loc]Tavern[/loc]. To be precise, the midwife delivered me right on that table in the corner.

My father is the owner, and I have been helping him since I was a kid. I know practically everyone around here. For the right price I can arrange this and that, and for [shadow]friends[/shadow] I have preferential rates:blink:
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DN_003:
[loc]Blunderhaven[/loc]? It may not be [loc]Rome[/loc], but we have everything we need here. People know each other and help one another.

On a daily basis it is peaceful here, though sometimes outsiders cause quite a mess. Just like yesterday - we had three unknown [char]wizards[/] here, and everything would have been fine if it were not for some [shadow]slicker[/shadow] who tried to cheat them at cards:angry:.

I do not know exactly what happened over there, because I was in the kitchen at the time, but by the end things got [shadow]heated[/shadow]. I heard some bang and screams:shocked:. Apparently they used their [shadow]magic[/shadow]. Tsk, what a rabble, who ever heard of using spells at a table:evil:.
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DO_003to007_1: Spells? Here? That is unheard of! What happened next?
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DO_003to008_2: I am afraid [shadow]I[/shadow] am the unfortunate one they cast a spell on:miserable:
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DO_003to007_3: [char]Sword[/char]: [italic]I think I have heard this story already...[/italic] But what about those [char]wizards[/]?
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DN_007: They are spoiling the peace for weary locals. Thankfully the [char]wizards[/] left quickly. They certainly would not have got a room here. My father and the lads would have chased them off in no time:angry:.
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DO_007to001_9: Thanks, that is enough for me
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DN_008: It was you? Now that is quite the story! You are not hurt, are you?
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DO_008to009_1: I think my adventuring days are over - they cast the [quest]Eternal Curse of Misfortune[/quest] on me
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DO_008to009_2: Well, if you have anything for sale against the [quest]Eternal Curse of Misfortune[/quest], I am very interested
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DO_008to009_3: I need someone who can break the [quest]Eternal Curse of Misfortune[/quest]
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DN_009:
Ah! The [quest]Eternal Curse of Misfortune[/quest]? Seriously? I thought that was just my mother talking...

Well then. Tough business. Nobody here will really help [shadow]you[/shadow]. We have no [shadow]magic[/shadow] around here. Go ask [char]Potioneer Puzzlemint[/char], she probably cannot do much herself, but she might well know something. She is distrustful of outsiders, so tell her [shadow]I[/shadow] sent you.
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DO_009to001_9: Thanks, that is enough for me
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DN_004: Well, there are a few [loc]villages[/] around here, but ours is the biggest, the rest is rubbish. Are you interested in any particular place?
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DO_004to010_1: I do not know any specific places around here. Can you tell me more generally?
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DO_004to011_2: What can you tell me about the city of [loc]Quirkshire[/loc]?
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DO_004to018_3: What can you tell me about the [loc]Swamp of Inconvenience[/loc]?
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DO_004to019_4: What can you tell me about the [loc]Tangled Forest of Annoyance[/loc]?
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DO_004to020_5: What can you tell me about the [loc]Caverns of Confusion[/loc]?
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DO_004to001_9: Thanks, that is enough for me
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DN_010:
Generally speaking, some [italic]mischief[/italic] lurks everywhere and it is better to stay in the [loc]village[/].

Come back when you want to ask about a specific [loc]place[/].
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DO_010to001_9: Thanks, that is enough for me
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DN_018: The [loc]Swamp of Inconvenience[/loc] is one big... well, [shadow]swamp[/shadow]. There is nothing interesting there.
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DO_018to004_9: Thanks, that is enough for me
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DN_019: The [loc]Tangled Forest of Annoyance[/loc] can be interesting. Especially after dark. Besides what you find in ordinary forests - [shadow]wolves[/shadow], [shadow]bears[/shadow] and [shadow]forest pumas[/shadow] - there are [shadow]trolls[/shadow], [shadow]werewolves[/shadow] and even [shadow]vampires[/shadow]. Or so they say.
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DO_019to004_9: Thanks, that is enough for me
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DN_020: I have never been to the [loc]Caverns of Confusion[/loc] myself. I do not like such places - dark, cold, no beer:blink:.
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DO_020to004_9: Thanks, that is enough for me
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DN_011:
Oh yes, well, it is a proper city, I will give them that. They have some [num]3[/num] [loc]taverns[/], bigger than ours. And there is no muck lying on the streets. People walk around in funny colourful little jackets, and they talk a bit differently too.

It is probably because of all those [shadow]books[/shadow], because they even have a [loc]library[/loc] over there. Apparently you can learn a lot from books. Though they probably only write forbidden things about [shadow]spells[/shadow] and other nonsense.

Who has time to read books? Better to sit outside with a beer. That is [shadow]living[/shadow]!
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DO_011to017_1: Do you happen to know how to get there?
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DO_011to017_2: It must be far from here, right?
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DO_011to017_3: And if I wanted to try their local [item]beer[/], where should I look for those [italic]colourful little jackets[/italic]?
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DN_017: It is some [num]2[/num] days' journey [shadow]north[/shadow]. Past the [loc]Tangled Forest of Annoyance[/loc] you turn [shadow]east[/shadow].
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DO_017to001_9: Thanks, that is enough for me
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DN_005: About [shadow]spells[/shadow]? Ah, tsk! The devil's charm:angry:. Why would anyone be interested in that? It is pure [shadow]evil[/shadow]. Why do you need to know?
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DO_005to012_1: Oh, no, nothing, you know, I have this embarrassing [shadow]affliction[/shadow]. I am looking for someone who could help me:dots:
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DO_005to013_2: Bah, what would [shadow]you[/shadow] know, you have not seen the world beyond this village. Talk when I ask!
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DO_005to012_3: Oh no, a friend is asking
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DO_005to001_9: Thanks, that is enough for me
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DN_012:
Ah, I see. Hmmm, well then, maybe only old [char]Potioneer Puzzlemint[/char] could help. She can prepare a [item]potion[/item] that gets you back on your feet in no time. Unless she mixes something up, because she is old and blind.

Sometimes folk get even worse after those [item]potions[/item]. If you are desperate you can try. She sits in a hut at the end of the village, near the forest. Tell her [shadow]I[/shadow] sent you.
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DO_012to001_9: Thanks, that is enough for me
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DN_013: Hey:red_exclamation: None of that tone! If you do not like it, [italic]good day to you[/italic].
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DO_013to001_9: Let us talk about something else
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DN_006: Listen, you are not looking to learn [shadow]magic[/shadow] yourself, are you? What type of [shadow]magic[/shadow] interests you specifically?
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DO_006to014_1: Something that helps me talk to women:blink:
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DO_006to016_3: Something more on the healing side:cross:
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DO_006to001_9: No, come on, what are [shadow]you[/shadow] on about. Never mind, let us talk about something else
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DN_014: What:red_question: You want to seduce our village girls with [shadow]spells[/shadow]?
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DO_014to991_1: No, no, it is not like that...
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DN_015: And what? You will want to cheat at cards? Or better yet, use [shadow]spells[/shadow] to bewitch me during a trade! Oh you!:angry:
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DO_015to991_1: No, no, it is not like that...
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DN_016: And what [shadow]disease[/shadow] is it that you want to cure with [shadow]spells[/shadow]? It must be some kind of [shadow]plague[/shadow]! You have brought some filth into our village:red_exclamation:
EN.M_BARMAN_ABSINTHRAYNER_DO_016to991_1: No, no, it is not like that...
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DN_001:
So you are still alive, barely...:frounce:
At this rate I will rust away next to [shadow]your[/shadow] skeleton. What a mess. You really outdid yourself yesterday - gambling with [char]wizards[/], and with marked cards at that! You asked for it, so suffer now.

I am not helping you.

Do not even ask.
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DO_001to002_1: Come on, do not be like that. Can you not see I am in need?
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DO_001to002_2: Tell me what you know! I do not have the strength for games right now.
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DO_001to002_3: Since you did not help me yesterday, here we are. Shall we start over?
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DN_002: Alright, alright, fine. Ask away. What do you want to know?
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DN_003:
Your [italic]cavalry spirit[/italic] got the better of you! Yet again!
You wanted to beat the newly arrived [char]wizards[/] at cards, got drunk and stopped listening to me. They caught you trying to cheat, cast some spell, and then there was one big bang and a flash.

That is when I lost consciousness, and we woke up [shadow]here[/shadow].
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DO_003to008_1: Hehe, well, that was quite the adventure.
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DO_003to008_2: Big deal, just another day. Why all the drama?
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DO_003to008_3: So I did not win anything, hmm. Maybe today I will break the streak.
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DN_004:
Really? You got so wasted that you do not even remember me? It is odd that a fool like you managed to survive this long.

I, if you please, am [shadow]your[/shadow] one and only, most faithful companion. Not that I have much choice - you keep me at your belt, and I cannot walk on my own. So I am the involuntary witness to every one of [shadow]your[/shadow] [italic]exploits[/italic].

I am a sword, forged from the soul of fire, and besides a sharp edge I have an equally sharp tongue. My name is [char]Clapback Sword[/char], and if only you could wield me skillfully, we would be invincible.
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DO_004to008_1: Oh, I see. Thanks for clearing that up. What would I do without [shadow]you[/shadow]?
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DO_004to008_2: You talk as if you were my mother. I am an adult, I can do whatever I want.
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DO_004to008_3: A [char]clapback[/] is not just [shadow]your[/shadow] name, it is [shadow]your[/shadow] specialty - a real riot.
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DN_005:
We are in the splendid land of filth and stench called [loc]Knaveshire[/loc]. Most people here are poor villagers. There are a few [shadow]craftsmen[/shadow] and a few [shadow]magicians[/shadow]. Although most of them are quacks, herbalists, charlatans and other frauds who know nothing of real [shadow]magic[/shadow].

On the roads you might still meet the remnants of the [shadow]Blue Knighthood[/shadow], but it is not what it used to be.

In the forests, caves and dark alleys lurk all sorts of monstrosities craving blood, money, or both. The rest are adventurers, like [shadow]you[/shadow].

And I suppose, by association, [shadow]me[/shadow] as well.
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DO_005to016_1: Alright, that is the [shadow]big picture[/shadow], but what [loc]place[/] is this?
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DO_005to016_2: I do not need a lecture. I asked where [shadow]heeere[/shadow] and [shadow]nooow[/shadow] actually is.
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DO_005to016_3: Fine, but which exact stinking corner of this [italic]wonderful[/italic] [loc]kingdom[/] are we in?
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DN_016:
Oh, right. For reasons unknown to me, you dragged us to the ruined village of [loc]Blunderhaven[/loc] in the county of [loc]Muckshire[/loc].

Yesterday you were causing a scene in the local [loc]Tavern[/loc], and now, judging by the smell, we are probably in a [loc]stable[/loc].
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DO_016to008_1: Alright, thanks - it clears up some of the [italic]fog[/italic] in my head.
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DO_016to008_2: I must say, that does not sound too inviting.
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DO_016to008_3: Ah, yes - that rustic [italic]scent[/italic], hmmm, delightful.
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DN_008: What else do you want to know?
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DO_008to006_4: So, what do we do now?
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DN_006: I am afraid the situation is more serious than it may seem. Those [char]wizards[/] did not just take our money and knock us out, they also put some [quest]curse[/] on [shadow]you[/shadow].
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DO_006to007_1: Hmm, I do not remember anything. What [quest]curse[/] are you talking about?
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DO_006to007_2: Stop scaring me all the time. I am a bit banged up, but nothing major happened.
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DO_006to007_3: Having to listen to [shadow]your[/shadow] complaints is the only [quest]curse[/] that ever befell me.
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DN_007:
I do not remember everything either.

Check your pockets and your [item]bag[/], maybe we will find some [quest]clue[/].
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DO_007to009_1: You were right - they stripped us of everything.
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DO_007to009_2: Empty - what are we going to do now?
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DO_007to009_3: Wind is blowing through the pockets. So this is going to be one of those '[shadow]from zero to hero[/shadow]' stories?
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DN_009:
Then have a look around.

Look there, by the wall!

It is some kind of [shadow]scroll[/shadow].
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DN_010:
No, no, no! Anything but that! The [quest]Eternal Curse of Misfortune[/quest] is a massacre.

I am the last one to defend you, but [shadow]THAAAT[/shadow] kind of punishment is going way too far.
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DO_010to011_2: Hey! Stop shaking and get to the point.
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DO_010to011_3: Hey, slow down, what does that actually mean?
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DN_011:
Alright, one thing at a time. This is a very old [quest]curse[/]. Mothers scare naughty children with it, card players warn against it, but I do not know anyone who ever fell victim to it.

They say the person it touches has constant [shadow]bad luck[/shadow] in life - in cards you only ever draw low, the wind always blows in your face, and in a storm the lightning picks you specifically.

So basically you are thor... [shadow]thoroughly doomed[/shadow].
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DO_011to012_1: And how long does this [quest]curse[/] last?
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DO_011to013_2: We have to catch those [char]wizards[/] - they have to lift this spell.
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DO_011to014_3: Or maybe we make a fortune touring with the famous [quest]curse[/] live on stage?
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DN_012: [shadow]You[/shadow] really did take a hard blow to the head. The [shadow]Eternal[/shadow] [quest]curse[/quest] - the matter is obvious.
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DO_012to015_1: So what? Am I supposed to lie down and wait for death?
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DN_013: Oh, mother of all swords forged from the soul of fire! How do [shadow]you[/shadow] imagine that going? There are [num]three[/] of them, you cannot wield [char]the Sword[/char] any better than a snotty kid in his underwear, and [shadow]they[/shadow] are most likely long gone.
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DO_013to015_1: So what? Am I supposed to lie down and wait for death?
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DN_014: Ha, ha, ha. That is a real knee-slapper. Now you feel like cracking jokes?
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DO_014to015_1: So what? Am I supposed to lie down and wait for death?
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DN_015:
Alright, let us think:wondering:. What we know so far about this [quest]curse[/] is a mix of children's tales and bards' ramblings. We need to find out more specifics.

One thing is certain - if you have always thought deep down that you are [shadow]special[/shadow], now you have your proof. You are special - you have [shadow]exceptionally[/shadow] bad luck!

Now let us hit the road! We need to ask the people around here. I would start at the [loc]Tavern[/loc], because that is where we will find most of the villagers.
EN.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DN_100: I have nothing new to tell you right now.
EN.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DN_016: Who are you? Who sent you here?
EN.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DO_016to992_2: Nobody, I found my own way here.
EN.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DN_000: Ah, yes, yes. Come in, boy, welcome to the home of the finest herbalist in the area.
EN.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DO_000to001_1: Good day, I am [char]Malachi[/char], a terribly unlucky man. I need help.
EN.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DO_000to001_2: I am not a boy, I am a grown man - call me [char]Malachi[/char]!
EN.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DO_000to001_3: So it is [shadow]you[/shadow] who grows all these [italic]little herbs[/italic] here?
EN.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DO_001to002_1: [shadow]You[/shadow] have lived here a long time, have you not?
EN.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DO_001to003_2: Has this [loc]village[/] always been in such a sorry state?
EN.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DO_001to004_3: Are there any more interesting places in the [loc]area[/]?
EN.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DO_001to005_4: Besides herbalism, do [shadow]you[/shadow] also know about [quest]spells[/]?
EN.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DO_001to006_5: Do [shadow]you[/shadow] happen to have a book about [quest]spells[/]?
EN.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DO_001to990_9: That is all, until next time.
EN.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DN_002:
In recent years I have indeed not ventured beyond [loc]Blunderhaven[/loc], but I used to travel more. I have been to places few people ever got access to. I no longer have the strength for it.

People come to me now of their own accord and pay me for my help. Everyone here treats me with the respect I am due. That is only natural, given my knowledge of [item]herbs[/].

And [shadow]you[/shadow] are new here, I have not seen [shadow]you[/shadow] before. What is your sign?
EN.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DO_002to008_1: I am a [shadow]Libra[/shadow] - the nicest sign of the zodiac, do you not think?
EN.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DO_002to007_2: [shadow]Astrology[/shadow] is nonsense! Everyone decides for themselves what kind of person they are.
EN.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DO_002to008_3: A Joker! I am like a [shadow]chameleon[/shadow] - I become someone else depending on what the moment calls for.
EN.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DN_007: Oh, you are still young and, as I can see, naive. May fate not make a mockery of [shadow]your[/shadow] pride.
EN.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DO_007to001_9: Let us change the subject then.
EN.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DN_008: Riiiight, how interesting... Tell me more about yourself. You must have some trouble, since you ended up here. What happened to [shadow]you[/shadow]?
EN.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DO_008to009_1: It is embarrassing to say. I caused trouble and [char]wizards[/] cast the [quest]Eternal Curse of Misfortune[/] on me.
EN.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DO_008to009_2: Some vile [char]wizards[/] put a spell on me and [shadow]bad luck[/shadow] keeps hounding me.
EN.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DO_008to009_3: From what I have managed to establish, I am under the [quest]Eternal Curse of Misfortune[/].
EN.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DN_009: Oh, my poppet, you must have offended them badly. That is a very old [quest]curse[/] and hardly anyone reaches for it. I have no remedy for it. All I can give you is a [item]Potion of Oblivion[/item], but that will hardly solve the problem.
EN.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DO_009to001_9: A pity. Let us talk about something else, then.
EN.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DN_003:
What can I say? A village is a village, they all look alike around here. People have learned that they are on their own.

True, we have no [shadow]miller[/shadow] and no [shadow]woodcutter[/shadow], but our [shadow]blacksmith[/shadow] is better than in many a city. [char]Hammer Hoaxheart[/char] may not be the life of the party, but he claims his gear is exquisite.
EN.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DO_003to001_9: Thanks, that is enough for me.
EN.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DN_004:
There is a fair bit of it, the question is what counts as interesting for whom:

1. The [loc]Swamp of Inconvenience[/loc] is rich in [shadow]herbs[/shadow] and all manner of [shadow]toads[/shadow]
2. in the [loc]Tangled Forest of Annoyance[/loc] you can find rare [shadow]mushrooms[/shadow] and various kinds of [shadow]medicinal bark[/shadow]
3. The [loc]Caverns of Confusion[/loc] are also a source of [shadow]mushrooms[/shadow], but far more dangerous
EN.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DO_004to001_9: Thanks, that is enough for me.
EN.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DN_005:
No, no, none of that. [shadow]Magic[/shadow] is some devilish invention. I trust what nature gives us. Everything we need can be drawn out of herbs and animal extracts. You only have to know your craft.

The way I do.
EN.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DO_005to010_1: Then perhaps [shadow]you[/shadow] will take pity on me and make me stop being an eternal [italic]unlucky wretch[/italic]?
EN.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DO_005to010_2: Really? Then I would like something to turn my [italic]unlucky[/italic] life around.
EN.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DO_005to010_3: So if I eat a [item]four-leaf clover[/] I will never have [italic]bad luck[/italic] again?
EN.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DN_010: It is not that simple, my boy. [shadow]Fortune[/shadow] is written for us in the stars and nothing will change that now. Accept your fate humbly.
EN.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DO_010to001_9: I see, let us move on to something else.
EN.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DN_006: Books? About [shadow]magic[/shadow]? I have no use for those. I spent years experimenting with plants and extracts until I got the effect I wanted. Books can lie - nature never!
EN.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DO_006to011_1: Yes, yes, naturally. But have [shadow]you[/shadow] perhaps heard of such tomes?
EN.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DO_006to991_2: So that means [shadow]you[/shadow] experimented on people, taking their money, even though it sometimes ended tragically?
EN.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DO_006to011_3: What a shame, I badly need to learn more about [quest]spells[/].
EN.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DN_011:

EN.M_MADAME_SARCASMIA_DN_000: Well, well, well, what do we have here? Another lost soul seeking a cure, I presume? Raises an eyebrow :wondering:.

EN.M_MADAME_SARCASMIA_DO_000to007_3: Can you tell me a bit more about yourself?

EN.M_MADAME_SARCASMIA_DO_007to009_2: Are there any recent developments or news around these parts?

[loc]Gafowo Kolonia[/loc]? Może to nie jest [loc]Rzym[/loc], ale mamy tu wszystko co nam potrzeba. Ludzie się znają i wzajemnie sobie pomagają.

Chciałeś ograć w karty nowoprzybyłych [char]czarodziei[/], spiłeś się i przestałeś mnie słuchać. Oni przyłapali Cię na próbie oszustwa, rzucili jakieś zaklęcie, potem był jeden wielki huk i błysk.

Wtedy straciłem przytomność a obudziliśmy się [shadow]tutaj[/shadow].

Ja, proszę ja Ciebie, jestem [shadow]Twoim[/shadow] jedynym i najwierniejszym kompanem. Nie to żebym miał jakiś wybór - trzymasz mnie za pasem, a ja nie potrafię sam chodzić. Jestem więc mimowolnym świadkiem wszystkich [shadow]Twoich[/shadow] [italic]wyczynów[/italic].

Jestem mieczem, wykutym z duszy ognia i prócz ciętego ostrza, mam równie cięty język. Nazywam się [char]Miecz Ciętej-riposty[/char] i gdybyś tylko potrafił mną sprawnie władać, bylibyśmy niezwyciężeni.
PL.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DO_004to008_1: Och, rozumiem. Dzięki za rozjaśnienie sytuacji. Co ja bym bez [shadow]Ciebie[/shadow] zrobił?
PL.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DO_004to008_2: Mówisz, jak byś był moją matką. Jestem dorosły mogę robić co chcę.
PL.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DO_004to008_3: [char]Cięta riposta[/] to nie tylko [shadow]Twoje[/shadow] imię, ale i [shadow]Twoja[/shadow] specjalność - no boki zrywać.
PL.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DN_005:
Jesteśmy we wspaniałej krainie brudu i smrodu zwanej [loc]Królestwem Pomylenia[/loc]. Większość ludzi tutaj, to biedni wieśniacy. Na szlakach spotkać można czasami resztki przedstawicieli [shadow]Błękitnego Rycerstwa[/shadow], ale to już nie to samo co kiedyś.

W lasach, jaskiniach i ciemnych zaułkach czają się różne maszkary żądne krwi, pieniędzy lub jednego i drugiego. Reszta to poszukiwacze przygód, jak [shadow]Ty[/shadow].

No i chyba siłą rzeczy [shadow]ja[/shadow] też.
PL.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DO_005to016_1: Ok, to tak [shadow]globalnie[/shadow], ale co to za [loc]miejsce[/]?
PL.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DO_005to016_2: Nie wiem po co mi ten wykład. Pytałem gdzie [shadow]tuuu[/shadow] i [shadow]teeeraz[/shadow] jesteśmy.

PL.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DO_006to007_1: Hmm, nic sobie nie przypominam. O jaką  [quest]klątwę[/] chodzi?

Sprawdź kieszenie i [item]torbę[/], może znajdziemy jakiś  [quest]trop[/].

To może rozejrzyj się dookoła.

Patrz tam, pod ścianą!

To jakiś [shadow]pergamin[/shadow].

Ja tam jestem ostatni żeby Cię bronić, ale [shadow]TAAAKA[/shadow] kara to gruba przesada.

PL.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DO_012to015_1: To co? Mam położyć się i czekać na śmierć?
PL.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DN_013: O, macierzy wszystkich mieczy duszy ognia! Jak [shadow]Ty[/shadow] to sobie niby wyobrażasz? Ich jest [num]trzech[/], Ty nie umiesz władać [char]Mieczem[/char] lepiej niż byle smarkacz w kalesonach, a najpewniej [shadow]oni[/shadow] już dawno odjechali.
PL.M_CLAPBACK_SWORD_DO_013to015_1: To co? Mam położyć się i czekać na śmierć?

PL.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DN_009: O bratku, to musiałeś bardzo im się narazić. To bardzo stara [quest]klątwa[/] i rzadko kto po nią sięga. Ja nie mam na to lekarstwa. Jedynie mogę Ci dać [item]Miksturę Zapomnienia[/item], ale to raczej nie rozwiąże problemu.
PL.M_POTIONEER_PUZZLEMINT_DO_009to001_9: Szkoda. Porozmawiajmy w takim razie o czymś innym.

Co prawda nie mamy [shadow]młynarza[/shadow] ani [shadow]drwala[/shadow], ale za to nasz [shadow]kowal[/shadow] jest lepszy niż w niejednym mieście. [char]Kowal Kłamca[/char] nie jest może duszą towarzystwa, ale twierdzi, że rynsztunek robi wyśmienity.

PL.M_MADAME_SARCASMIA_DO_000to001_1: Uh, tak, właśnie. Słyszałem, że jesteś potężną czarodziejką i miałem nadzieję, że pomożesz mi przełamać tę… [quest]odwieczną klątwę ciągłego pecha[/quest].

PL.M_MADAME_SARCASMIA_DO_001to002_2: Cóż, a to pech, bo miałem zamiar ci zapłacić wyrazami wdzięczności.
PL.M_MADAME_SARCASMIA_DN_002: Och, zrobię to, nie martw się. Widzisz kochanieńki, potrzebuję jedynie kilku drobiazgów do mojego małego… projektu. Zdobądź je dla mnie, a być może przygotuję Ci eliksir, który [italic]teoretycznie[/italic] może złamać twoją klątwę. Albo zamieni Cię w traszkę. To się jeszcze zobaczy:blink:
PL.M_MADAME_SARCASMIA_DO_002to003_1: Drobiazgi, mówisz? O czym konkretnie mówimy?
PL.M_MADAME_SARCASMIA_DO_002to003_2: To będzie bułka z masłem, prawda?

PL.M_MADAME_SARCASMIA_DN_005: A teraz idź już. Raz, raz. A jeśli uda ci się przeżyć, rozważę uwarzenie tego „lekarstwa", którego tak pragniesz. Jednak pamiętaj, że nie przyjmuję żadnych zwrotów. Ta-da!
PL.M_MADAME_SARCASMIA_DN_006: Och, nie bądź taką księżniczką :love:. A teraz idź już, raz, raz. A jeśli uda ci się przeżyć, rozważę uwarzenie tego „lekarstwa", którego tak pragniesz. Jednak pamiętaj, że nie przyjmuję żadnych zwrotów. Ta-da!

PL.M_MADAME_SARCASMIA_DN_012: Och, ale mnie zaskoczyłeś. Wygląda na to, że udało ci się oszukać sam los i zebrać wszystkie trzy absurdalne przedmioty. Dawaj je teraz, a zobaczymy, czy moja magia jest w stanie wyczarować to cudeńko, którego tak desperacko pragniesz.

PL.M_MADAME_SARCASMIA_DO_016to019_1: Kto w ogóle potrzebuje lekarstwa, prawda?
PL.M_MADAME_SARCASMIA_DN_017: O wy małej wiary! Dawaj je tutaj i zobaczmy, czy twoje wysiłki poszły na marne, czy nie.
PL.M_MADAME_SARCASMIA_DO_017to020_1: Mam schować się za tą wielką skrzynią?
PL.M_MADAME_SARCASMIA_DN_018: Och, jakież to urocze! Zrobię, co mogę, z tą niekompletną kolekcją, którą udało ci się zgromadzić.

Bajki dla dzieci i bajania bardów to za mało, żeby cokolwiek z tym zrobić.

PL.M_QUEST_Q03_S03_HOW_TO_GET_THERE_DESCRIP: Miasto jest gdzieś na północy. "[italic]Gdzieś[/italic]" to stanowczo za mało, żeby ruszać w drogę.

Wiedzieć o [quest]klątwie[/] to jedno, a zdjąć ją to zupełnie inna para kaloszy.
